title: An issue in @rog0x/mcp-docker-tools 1.0.1 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the handleImageList function. (CVE-2026-106765)
description: A vulnerability in @rog0x/mcp-docker-tools version 1.0.1 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via the handleImageList function. This issue has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. The vulnerability requires user interaction and has a high attack complexity. No affected versions beyond 1.0.1 are explicitly stated, and no patch or remediation information is provided.
aiSummary: The @rog0x/mcp-docker-tools package version 1.0.1 contains a vulnerability in the handleImageList function that permits remote code execution. The CVSS 3.1 vector indicates network attack vector, high attack complexity, no privileges required, user interaction required, unchanged scope, and high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No patch or vendor advisory details are available to confirm remediation status.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system, potentially leading to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system running the vulnerable software.
